verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line saying 'Screening and secure services keep apps safe.' It hints at some app screening, but nothing documents a security review of generated code that runs before publishing. Other mentions of building 'securely from day one' describe secure built-in services, not a review of the app. Missing for 10: documented pre-publish security scanning or review of generated app code, details on what issues are detected and how they are reported or fixed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
